changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.90[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Real-Debrid filter brought up to date: it now follows the two rules Real-Debrid actually applies. Releases tagged AMZN, NF, DSNP, CR or WEBDL were hidden although Real-Debrid plays them, and they are back; BDRip, HDRip and DVDRip releases, which Real-Debrid refuses, no longer reach the list.
-Next episode: after a season finale the add-on offers episode 1 of the next season instead of an episode that does not exist, and offers nothing when the next one has not aired or the series is over.
-Rating on Trakt no longer needs the separate Trakt add-on: Rate and Unrate talk to Trakt directly, for movies, shows, seasons and episodes.
-The source list showed subtitle languages as if they were audio. Flags from indexers are only taken as audio when the release name backs them up; when the file itself has been read and its tracks carry no language, the list says so instead.
-Browsing is lighter on the metadata database: a title that is not cached yet no longer makes the add-on read the whole table.
-If a trailer cannot be played, for example because it is blocked in your country, the next one is tried automatically.
[COLOR fffdb515]Binge watching[/COLOR]
-The next episode now plays with a source like the one you were watching: same quality, same HDR or Dolby Vision, same audio language, same release group, same scraper and debrid service. SDR stays SDR. If nothing matches, the usual order applies.
-Its sources are loaded quietly in the background while you watch, so Auto-Play starts at once.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trailers[/COLOR]
-New Trailer language setting: the language of the Kodi interface (default)
-On a series, the trailer of the season you are on comes first, and trailers now carry the plot and tagline for the skin to show.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt and SIMKL[/COLOR]
-Trakt: add to and remove from your favourites
-New SIMKL Manager in the context menu: rate from 1 to 10, remove a rating, add to Plan to Watch and remove from your SIMKL lists.
[COLOR fffdb515]Faster and lighter[/COLOR]
-Source lists are stored compressed: about eight times smaller on disk, read much faster, and scrapers no longer queue behind each other to read them.
-Devices with little memory keep a smaller source cache, and searches still running when Kodi closes no longer hold the shutdown.
